query: Please develop a website similar to Twilio and Msg91 for sending and managing messages. The website should have functionalities for sending SMS, managing message templates, and viewing sending records. Users should be able to log in, create and edit message templates, send SMS, view sending records, and manage account information. Set pale rose as the body background and use maroon for the UI.
